blocks.zh: 第二節：原則（含污染控制策略 CCS 深度解析）
blocks.en: Section 2: Principle (including an In-Depth Analysis of the Contamination Control Strategy, CCS)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握無菌產品製造的七大關鍵原則（2.1–2.7），理解其系統性邏輯與優先順序
blocks.en: Master the seven key principles of sterile product manufacturing (2.1–2.7) and understand their systematic logic and order of priority

blocks.zh: 深入理解污染控制策略 (CCS, Contamination Control Strategy) 的定義、組成元素與建立方法
blocks.en: Understand in depth the definition, constituent elements and establishment of the Contamination Control Strategy (CCS)

blocks.zh: 了解 QRM 在整體製造管理中的首要性：「設計先行，監控驗證」的思維模式
blocks.en: Understand the primacy of QRM in overall manufacturing management: the mindset of "design first, then monitor and verify"

blocks.zh: 認識 CCS 的 16 個構成要素，以及如何在 CDMO 環境中實際建立與維護 CCS
blocks.en: Know the 16 elements of a CCS and how to establish and maintain a CCS in practice in a CDMO environment

blocks.zh: 理解為何「單靠監控或測試不能保證無菌性」——無菌保證來自整體系統設計
blocks.en: Understand why "monitoring or testing alone cannot assure sterility": sterility assurance comes from the design of the whole system

blocks.zh: 2.1 — Key Areas for Sterile Manufacturing / 無菌製造的關鍵考量領域
blocks.en: 2.1 - Key Areas for Sterile Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 三種污染類型（Three Contamination Types）：
blocks.en: Three Contamination Types:

blocks.zh: 微生物污染（Microbial Contamination）： 細菌、黴菌、酵母菌等活微生物直接造成感染風險
blocks.en: Microbial Contamination: Living microorganisms such as bacteria, moulds and yeasts pose a direct infection risk

blocks.zh: 微粒污染（Particulate Contamination）： 可見或不可見微粒可能造成靜脈栓塞、組織損傷
blocks.en: Particulate Contamination: Visible or sub-visible particles may cause venous embolism or tissue damage

blocks.zh: 內毒素/熱原污染（Endotoxin/Pyrogen Contamination）： 革蘭氏陰性菌的細胞壁碎片，即使菌體已死亡仍會引發發熱反應（fever response），是無菌製造中最難被完全排除的污染類型
blocks.en: Endotoxin/Pyrogen Contamination: Fragments of the cell wall of Gram-negative bacteria that still trigger a fever response even after the cells have died; this is the type of contamination that is hardest to eliminate completely in sterile manufacturing

blocks.zh: 屏障技術優先（Barrier Technology First）： RABS（限制進出屏障系統）和 Isolator（隔離器）代表了現代無菌製造的技術趨勢。Annex 1 (2022) 明確要求廠商「應考慮」使用這些技術，間接表明傳統開放式潔淨室設計（open cleanroom）在法規眼中已非最佳選項。
blocks.en: Barrier Technology First: RABS (restricted access barrier systems) and isolators represent the technical trend in modern sterile manufacturing. Annex 1 (2022) explicitly expects manufacturers to "consider" these technologies, which indirectly signals that the traditional open cleanroom design is no longer regarded by regulators as the best option.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 無菌製造的四大考量就像一間頂級外科手術室的管理：
blocks.en: The four key considerations in sterile manufacturing are like running a top-class operating theatre:

blocks.zh: 硬體設計（設施、設備）= 手術室的正壓空調、層流通風、光滑不藏菌的地板
blocks.en: Hardware design (facilities, equipment) = the theatre's positive-pressure air conditioning, laminar airflow and smooth floors that harbour no microbes

blocks.zh: 人員= 外科醫師的洗手程序、刷手衣穿著方式
blocks.en: Personnel = the surgeon's scrub-in procedure and the way surgical gowns are worn

blocks.zh: 製程監控= 術中生命體徵監測儀器
blocks.en: Process monitoring = the intra-operative vital-signs monitors

blocks.zh: 原物料管控= 手術器械的滅菌確認與生物指示劑
blocks.en: Control of materials = sterilisation qualification of the surgical instruments and biological indicators

blocks.zh: 少了任何一項，即使其他三項都做到位，病人仍可能感染。無菌製造也是如此——系統性的整體管控才能確保無菌保證 (Sterility Assurance，無菌保證)。
blocks.en: If any one of them is missing, the patient can still be infected even when the other three are fully in place. Sterile manufacturing is the same: only systematic, holistic control can deliver sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: Isolator vs RABS 的法規含義： Annex 1 (2022) 比舊版更積極地推薦使用隔離器（Isolator）和 RABS（限制進出屏障系統）。對 CDMO 而言，若現有設施仍為傳統 Grade A 開放充填，應在 CCS 中說明為何維持現有設計仍能提供足夠的污染防護，並附上風險評估文件。
blocks.en: Regulatory implications of isolator vs RABS: Annex 1 (2022) recommends isolators and RABS (restricted access barrier systems) more actively than the previous version. For a CDMO whose existing facility still uses traditional open filling in Grade A, the CCS should explain why the existing design still provides adequate contamination protection and attach the supporting risk assessment documents.

blocks.zh: 人員行為（Personnel Behaviour）特別強調： 注意 "behaviour"（行為）一詞。這不只是訓練問題，還涉及人員在潔淨室中的文化與習慣。法規近年越來越重視「行為偏差」（behavioural deviation）導致的污染風險。
blocks.en: Special emphasis on personnel behaviour: Note the word "behaviour". This is not only a training issue; it also concerns the culture and habits of personnel in the cleanroom. Regulators increasingly focus on the contamination risk caused by "behavioural deviations".

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼內毒素/熱原污染比微生物污染更難控制？終端滅菌（terminal sterilization）能消除熱原問題嗎？
blocks.en: Why is endotoxin/pyrogen contamination harder to control than microbial contamination? Can terminal sterilisation eliminate the pyrogen problem?

blocks.zh: 一條新的無菌充填線正在評估採用 RABS 還是 Isolator。從 Annex 1 的角度，兩者的主要差異是什麼？
blocks.en: A new aseptic filling line is evaluating RABS versus an isolator. From the Annex 1 perspective, what are the main differences between the two?

blocks.zh: 2.2 — QRM and Design Priority / 品質風險管理與設計優先原則
blocks.en: 2.2 - QRM and Design Priority

blocks.zh: 無菌保證的三層次優先順序：
blocks.en: The three-level order of priority for sterility assurance:

blocks.zh: 1. 設計（Design） — 最重要
blocks.en: 1. Design - the most important

blocks.zh: 2. 程序（Procedures）
blocks.en: 2. Procedures

blocks.zh: 3. 監控（Monitoring） — 驗證設計有效
blocks.en: 3. Monitoring - verifies that the design is effective

blocks.zh: 這個優先順序顛覆了許多廠商的直覺思維。「監控」在這裡是最後一層——它只是用來確認前兩層有效運作，而非污染防護的主要手段。如果廠商依賴大量環境監測數據來「證明」環境是乾淨的，而非透過良好設計來「預防」污染，這在 Annex 1 的哲學下是不被認可的。
blocks.en: This order of priority overturns the intuition of many manufacturers. Here "monitoring" is the last layer: it only confirms that the first two layers are working, and is not the main means of contamination protection. If a manufacturer relies on large volumes of environmental monitoring data to "prove" the environment is clean, rather than "preventing" contamination through good design, this is not accepted under the philosophy of Annex 1.

blocks.zh: 這就像建造一棟防水的房子：
blocks.en: It is like building a waterproof house:

blocks.zh: 設計先行：選擇正確的屋頂坡度、防水材料、排水系統設計（這才是真正防水的方法）
blocks.en: Design first: choose the right roof pitch, waterproofing materials and drainage design (this is what actually keeps the house waterproof)

blocks.zh: 程序：定期維護、檢查接縫、更換老化材料的 SOP
blocks.en: Procedures: SOPs for regular maintenance, checking joints and replacing aged materials

blocks.zh: 監控：在屋子裡放濕度計——如果它長期顯示乾燥，代表設計和程序都有效
blocks.en: Monitoring: place hygrometers in the house; if they show dry conditions over the long term, both the design and the procedures are working

blocks.zh: 若一棟房子的防水策略是「放很多濕度計，一旦潮濕就緊急處理」，這就是本末倒置。無菌保證 (Sterility Assurance) 的邏輯完全一樣。
blocks.en: If a house's waterproofing strategy is "put in lots of hygrometers and deal with it urgently whenever it gets damp", that is putting the cart before the horse. The logic of sterility assurance is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: 「監控不能保證無菌性」是 Annex 1 最重要的哲學宣示之一。 這句話的監管意義是：即使所有環境監測結果都合格，如果製程設計本身有缺陷（例如 Grade A 保護不足、人員動線不當），也不能宣稱產品是「安全無菌的」。
blocks.en: "Monitoring cannot assure sterility" is one of the most important philosophical statements in Annex 1. Its regulatory meaning is this: even if all environmental monitoring results are acceptable, if the process design itself is flawed (for example, inadequate Grade A protection or inappropriate personnel flows), the product cannot be claimed to be "safe and sterile".

blocks.zh: 這也是 PDA TR22（環境監測）中強調「監測是驗證工具，而非控制工具」的原因。
blocks.en: This is also why PDA TR22 (environmental monitoring) stresses that "monitoring is a verification tool, not a control tool".

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 在例行稽查準備時，稽查員要求審查環境監測（EM）的歷史趨勢。廠方展示了連續 12 個月 EM 全數合格的紀錄，並聲稱這證明無菌環境良好。
blocks.en: While preparing for a routine inspection, a CDMO is asked by the inspector to review the historical environmental monitoring (EM) trends. The company presents 12 consecutive months of EM records with no excursions and claims this proves that the aseptic environment is well controlled.

blocks.zh: 根據 Annex 1 的邏輯，稽查員的合理追問會是：「這些合格數據是因為系統設計良好，還是因為你們只在合格條件下才做充填？」——換言之，良好的設計文件和驗證報告才是真正的無菌保證，EM 只是支持性證據。
blocks.en: Following the logic of Annex 1, a reasonable follow-up question from the inspector would be: "Are these passing results due to a well-designed system, or because you only fill under conditions that pass?" In other words, good design documentation and validation reports are the real sterility assurance; EM is only supporting evidence.

blocks.zh: 2.3 — Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) / 污染控制策略（核心條款）
blocks.en: 2.3 - Contamination Control Strategy (CCS): The Core Clause

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — CCS 深度解析
blocks.en: Key Concepts - In-Depth Analysis of the CCS

blocks.zh: 什麼是污染控制策略（CCS）？
blocks.en: What is a Contamination Control Strategy (CCS)?

blocks.zh: CCS 是一份「活的」整合性文件，系統性地描述一家製造廠如何識別所有潛在污染源，並說明每個控制措施（設計、程序、技術、組織）如何協同運作，以確保產品品質與患者安全。
blocks.en: A CCS is a "living", integrated document that systematically describes how a manufacturer identifies all potential sources of contamination and how each control measure (design, procedural, technical and organisational) works together to ensure product quality and patient safety.

blocks.zh: CCS 包含四類控制措施：
blocks.en: A CCS covers four categories of control measures:

blocks.zh: 設計控制（Design Controls）： 潔淨室分級、氣流設計、HVAC 系統、RABS/Isolator 選擇
blocks.en: Design Controls: cleanroom classification, airflow design, HVAC systems, choice of RABS/isolator

blocks.zh: 程序控制（Procedural Controls）： 更衣規程、清潔消毒 SOP、人員行為規範
blocks.en: Procedural Controls: gowning procedures, cleaning and disinfection SOPs, rules of personnel behaviour

blocks.zh: 技術控制（Technical Controls）： 自動化系統、密閉系統（closed systems）、過濾器設計
blocks.en: Technical Controls: automated systems, closed systems, filter design

blocks.zh: 組織控制（Organisational Controls）： 培訓計劃、供應商資格審查、變更管理
blocks.en: Organisational Controls: training programmes, supplier qualification, change management

blocks.zh: 「定期管理審查的一部分」： 這是新要求。CCS 不只是一份文件，必須定期在管理層面審查其有效性，類似 ICH Q10 要求的產品品質年度審查（APR）。
blocks.en: "Part of the periodic management review": This is a new requirement. A CCS is not just a document; its effectiveness must be reviewed periodically at management level, similar to the annual product quality review (APR) expected under ICH Q10.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — CCS = 醫院感染管控計畫
blocks.en: Analogy - CCS = a Hospital Infection Control Plan

blocks.zh: CCS（污染控制策略）就像一家醫院的「感染管控計畫（hospital infection control plan）」。
blocks.en: A CCS (contamination control strategy) is like a hospital's infection control plan.

blocks.zh: 一家好醫院不會只說「我們有洗手規定」——它有一套完整的計畫，涵蓋：病房設計（負壓隔離病房）、人員管理（洗手程序、口罩規定）、環境清潔消毒（頻率、化學品選擇）、供應鏈管控（無菌耗材採購規格）、監控系統（院內感染率追蹤）、以及當發生群聚感染時的調查與 CAPA 流程。
blocks.en: A good hospital does not simply say "we have a hand-washing rule". It has a complete plan covering: ward design (negative-pressure isolation rooms), personnel management (hand-washing procedures, mask rules), environmental cleaning and disinfection (frequency, choice of chemicals), supply chain control (purchasing specifications for sterile consumables), a monitoring system (tracking of hospital-acquired infection rates), and the investigation and CAPA process when a cluster of infections occurs.

blocks.zh: 製藥廠的 CCS 也是如此——它是一份涵蓋廠內所有污染控制活動的「總計畫」，確保每個部分協調運作、相互支撐，並持續改善。
blocks.en: The same is true of a pharmaceutical plant's CCS: it is the "master plan" covering all contamination control activities in the plant, making sure every part is coordinated and mutually supportive and keeps improving.

blocks.zh: CCS 是 Annex 1 (2022) 最重要的新概念之一。 舊版 Annex 1 （2008 版）並未明確要求 CCS。2022 年新版將 CCS 從建議性概念升格為法規要求，這是此次修訂的最大變化之一。
blocks.en: The CCS is one of the most important new concepts in Annex 1 (2022). The previous Annex 1 (2008 version) did not explicitly require a CCS. The 2022 revision upgraded the CCS from a recommended concept to a regulatory requirement, which is one of the biggest changes in this revision.

blocks.zh: 現有系統不需要全部替換： 文中明確指出，若現有控制系統已到位且管理得當，「不需要替換」，但必須在 CCS 中引用，並理解各系統間的交互作用（interactions）。這是對既有廠商友善的表述，但同時要求廠商能說清楚各控制措施如何相互補充。
blocks.en: Existing systems do not all need to be replaced: The text states clearly that where existing control systems are in place and well managed, they "do not need to be replaced", but they must be referenced in the CCS and the interactions between the systems must be understood. This is favourable wording for established manufacturers, but it also requires them to be able to explain clearly how the individual control measures complement one another.

blocks.zh: 「持續改善（Continual Improvement）」的法規義務： CCS 必須推動持續改善，而非僅僅維持現狀。這意味著 CCS 的定期審查會議必須有改善行動的輸出。
blocks.en: The regulatory obligation of "continual improvement": The CCS must drive continual improvement, not merely maintain the status quo. This means the periodic review meetings of the CCS must produce improvement actions as an output.

blocks.zh: CCS 文件結構建議
blocks.en: Suggested CCS Document Structure

blocks.zh:
CCS 文件架構（建議）：
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. 廠房與環境設計概述
   - 潔淨室分級 (Grade A/B/C/D 級)
   - 氣流與壓差設計
   - RABS/Isolator 說明

2. 製程風險評估地圖
   - 識別所有關鍵控制點 (CCPs)
   - 每個 CCP 的控制措施清單

3. 四類控制措施彙總表
   - 設計 / 程序 / 技術 / 組織

4. 監控系統說明
   - 環境監測 (EM) 計畫
   - 製程中管控 (IPC) 項目

5. 績效指標與審查機制
   - 年度 CCS 有效性評估
   - 管理審查輸入

6. 持續改善記錄
   - CAPA 追蹤
   - 變更對 CCS 的影響評估
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
blocks.en:
Suggested CCS document structure:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. Overview of facility and environment design
   - Cleanroom classification (Grade A/B/C/D)
   - Airflow and pressure differential design
   - RABS/isolator description

2. Process risk assessment map
   - Identification of all critical control points (CCPs)
   - List of control measures for each CCP

3. Summary table of the four categories of control measures
   - Design / procedural / technical / organisational

4. Description of the monitoring system
   - Environmental monitoring (EM) programme
   - In-process control (IPC) items

5. Performance indicators and review mechanism
   - Annual CCS effectiveness assessment
   - Management review inputs

6. Continual improvement records
   - CAPA tracking
   - Impact assessment of changes on the CCS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 正在建立 CCS 文件。如果客戶要求查看 CCS，作為 CMO 方，你會提供完整文件還是摘要版本？從保密性和法規合規的角度如何平衡？
blocks.en: A CDMO is building its CCS document. If a client asks to see the CCS, as the CMO would you provide the complete document or a summary version? How do you balance confidentiality against regulatory compliance?

blocks.zh: CCS 要求「系統間交互作用應被理解」。請舉例說明：潔淨室 HVAC 系統設計與人員更衣程序之間的交互作用是什麼？
blocks.en: The CCS requires that "interactions between systems should be understood". Give an example: what is the interaction between the cleanroom HVAC system design and the personnel gowning procedure?

blocks.zh: 2.4–2.5 — Contamination Sources & CCS Elements / 污染來源與 CCS 的 16 個構成要素
blocks.en: 2.4-2.5 - Contamination Sources & CCS Elements: The 16 Elements of a CCS

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — CCS 的 16 個要素解讀
blocks.en: Key Concepts - Interpreting the 16 Elements of a CCS

blocks.zh: 「集體有效性」（Collective Effectiveness）概念：
blocks.en: The concept of "collective effectiveness":

blocks.zh: 每個控制措施可以個別評估，但真正的污染防護來自所有措施共同運作的系統效果。這就像一條鎖鏈——每個環節單獨都很強，但若某個環節薄弱，整條鏈的強度就只等於最弱的那一環。
blocks.en: Each control measure can be assessed individually, but real contamination protection comes from the combined effect of all measures working together as a system. It is like a chain: every link may be strong on its own, but if one link is weak, the strength of the whole chain equals that of its weakest link.

blocks.zh: 16 個要素的結構分析（按類別分組）：
blocks.en: Structural analysis of the 16 elements (grouped by category):

blocks.zh: 硬體與設計類（1-4）： 廠房設計、設施設備、人員、公用系統
blocks.en: Hardware and design (1-4): plant design, facilities and equipment, personnel, utilities

blocks.zh: 物料管控類（5-8）： 原料管控、容器密封系統、供應商資格、委外活動管理
blocks.en: Material control (5-8): raw material control, container closure systems, supplier qualification, management of outsourced activities

blocks.zh: 製程品質類（9-11）： 製程風險管理、製程驗證、滅菌驗證
blocks.en: Process quality (9-11): process risk management, process validation, sterilisation validation

blocks.zh: 維護與清潔類（12-13）： 預防性維護、清潔消毒
blocks.en: Maintenance and cleaning (12-13): preventive maintenance, cleaning and disinfection

blocks.zh: 監控與改善類（14-16）： 監控系統、預防機制（CAPA）、持續改善
blocks.en: Monitoring and improvement (14-16): monitoring systems, preventive mechanisms (CAPA), continual improvement

blocks.zh: 值得注意的是，供應商資格審查（vii）和委外活動管理（viii）首次明確列入 CCS 的組成要素，這對 CDMO 尤其重要——你的單次性使用系統（SUS）供應商的品質控制，也是你的 CCS 的一部分。
blocks.en: Note that supplier qualification (vii) and management of outsourced activities (viii) are listed explicitly as CCS elements for the first time. This matters especially for a CDMO: the quality control of your single-use systems (SUS) supplier is also part of your CCS.

blocks.zh: 把 CCS 的 16 個要素想像成一家餐廳的食品安全管理系統（HACCP）：
blocks.en: Imagine the 16 elements of a CCS as a restaurant's food safety management system (HACCP):

blocks.zh: 廚房設計（硬體）、食材採購規格（原料管控）、供應商稽核（供應商資格）、烹飪溫度管控（製程驗證）、清潔消毒計畫、員工衛生訓練——這些加在一起才構成完整的食品安全保證。
blocks.en: Kitchen design (hardware), ingredient purchasing specifications (raw material control), supplier audits (supplier qualification), cooking temperature control (process validation), a cleaning and disinfection plan, and staff hygiene training: only all of these together make up complete food safety assurance.

blocks.zh: 光有食材抽驗（等同於「監控」）並不足夠；光有 HACCP 文件而不落實也不夠。CCS 也是如此：它必須是系統性、活的、可執行的。
blocks.en: Spot-testing ingredients alone (the equivalent of "monitoring") is not enough, and neither is having HACCP documents that are not put into practice. The same applies to a CCS: it must be systematic, living and executable.

blocks.zh: 替代性監控方法（Alternative Methods）： 要素 xiv 特別提到評估「科學上合理的替代監測方法」——這是對快速微生物方法（Rapid Microbiological Methods, RMM）的隱性鼓勵。傳統 7-14 天培養基方法越來越難以滿足即時偏差響應的需求，RMM 是未來趨勢。
blocks.en: Alternative methods: Element xiv specifically mentions evaluating "scientifically justified alternative monitoring methods". This is an implicit encouragement of rapid microbiological methods (RMM). The traditional 7-14 day culture-media methods increasingly struggle to meet the need for real-time deviation response, and RMM is the future trend.

blocks.zh: CAPA 作為 CCS 的核心組件： 要素 xv 將 CAPA（矯正及預防行動）列為 CCS 的預防機制之一。這意味著 CAPA 系統的有效性應在 CCS 審查時一併評估——僅完成 CAPA 記錄填寫並不夠，必須驗證根本原因確實被解決。
blocks.en: CAPA as a core component of the CCS: Element xv lists CAPA (corrective and preventive action) as one of the preventive mechanisms of the CCS. This means the effectiveness of the CAPA system should be assessed as part of the CCS review: merely completing the CAPA records is not enough; it must be verified that the root cause has actually been resolved.

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 從傳統玻璃瓶充填改用單次性使用系統（Single-Use Systems, SUS）。在更新 CCS 時，哪些要素需要重點更新？
blocks.en: A CDMO switches from traditional glass vial filling to single-use systems (SUS). Which elements need particular attention when updating the CCS?

blocks.zh: 要素 vii（供應商資格）： 需評估 SUS 供應商的滅菌程序確認與生物相容性文件
blocks.en: Element vii (supplier qualification): evaluate the SUS supplier's sterilisation process qualification and biocompatibility documentation

blocks.zh: 要素 xi（滅菌驗證）： SUS 通常由供應商預先滅菌，需轉移並確認其滅菌驗證數據的適用性
blocks.en: Element xi (sterilisation validation): SUS are usually pre-sterilised by the supplier, so the applicability of the supplier's sterilisation validation data must be transferred and confirmed

blocks.zh: 要素 viii（委外活動）： 供應商的品質協議（Quality Agreement）必須明確界定責任邊界
blocks.en: Element viii (outsourced activities): the supplier's Quality Agreement must clearly define the boundaries of responsibility

blocks.zh: 要素 xii（預防性維護）： SUS 無需傳統 CIP/SIP，但需要更新批次設置確認程序
blocks.en: Element xii (preventive maintenance): SUS do not need traditional CIP/SIP, but the batch set-up verification procedure needs to be updated

blocks.zh: CCS 要素中「集體有效性」的概念，對於稽查中發現某一單一控制措施不足時（例如環境監測超標），其後續調查的範圍應該如何界定？
blocks.en: Given the concept of "collective effectiveness" in the CCS elements, how should the scope of the follow-up investigation be defined when an inspection finds that a single control measure is inadequate (for example, an environmental monitoring excursion)?

blocks.zh: 如果一家工廠的預防性維護計畫（PM）在 CCS 審查中被發現執行率只有 70%，這如何影響 CCS 的整體有效性評估？
blocks.en: If a plant's preventive maintenance (PM) programme is found during a CCS review to have only a 70% completion rate, how does this affect the overall CCS effectiveness assessment?

blocks.zh: 2.6–2.7 — CCS Lifecycle & Sterility Assurance / CCS 生命週期管理與無菌保證最終原則
blocks.en: 2.6-2.7 - CCS Lifecycle & Sterility Assurance: The Final Principles

blocks.zh: CCS 的生命週期管理（Lifecycle Management）：
blocks.en: Lifecycle management of the CCS:

blocks.zh: 2.6 確立了 CCS 不是一份靜態文件，而是隨著工廠運作持續演進的「活文件」。關鍵要求包括：
blocks.en: Clause 2.6 establishes that the CCS is not a static document but a "living document" that evolves continually as the plant operates. The key requirements include:

blocks.zh: 變更前評估： 任何製程變更（如設備更換、SOP 修改）在實施前必須評估對 CCS 的影響
blocks.en: Assessment before a change: any process change (such as an equipment replacement or an SOP revision) must be assessed for its impact on the CCS before implementation

blocks.zh: 變更後確認： 實施後也需確認 CCS 仍然有效
blocks.en: Confirmation after a change: after implementation, it must also be confirmed that the CCS is still effective

blocks.zh: 定期審查： 定期（通常每年）評估 CCS 整體有效性，作為 PQS 管理審查的輸入
blocks.en: Periodic review: the overall effectiveness of the CCS is evaluated periodically (usually annually) as an input to the PQS management review

blocks.zh: 2.7 的哲學意義——無菌保證來自整體系統：
blocks.en: The philosophical meaning of 2.7: sterility assurance comes from the whole system:

blocks.zh: 「不得單靠終端製程或成品測試來保證無菌性」是整個 Annex 1 的核心宣示。無菌性測試（Sterility Test）的統計侷限性眾所周知——對整批成品進行全破壞性測試是不可能的，抽樣測試的代表性有限。因此，無菌保證 (Sterility Assurance) 必須建立在整個製造系統的可靠性上。
blocks.en: "Sterility must not rely on terminal processing or finished product testing alone" is the core statement of the whole of Annex 1. The statistical limitations of the sterility test are well known: it is impossible to perform destructive testing on an entire batch of finished product, and the representativeness of sampling is limited. Sterility assurance must therefore be built on the reliability of the entire manufacturing system.

blocks.zh: 「不能單靠成品測試保證無菌性」就像——不能只靠最終的食品安全抽驗來確保食品安全。
blocks.en: "Sterility cannot be assured by finished product testing alone" is like the fact that food safety cannot be ensured only by a final food safety spot check.

blocks.zh: 一家便當工廠不可能對每一個便當做微生物檢測（破壞性且成本極高）。真正的食品安全保證來自原料管控、生產環境清潔、廚師健康管理、溫度控制等整套系統。每個便當的「安全性」是被「製造進去的」，而非「檢測出來的」。
blocks.en: A lunch-box factory cannot possibly run microbial tests on every single lunch box (it would be destructive and extremely costly). Real food safety assurance comes from the whole system: raw material control, a clean production environment, health management of the cooks, temperature control and so on. The "safety" of each lunch box is "manufactured in", not "tested out".

blocks.zh: 注射劑的無菌性也是如此：無菌性是透過完整的製造系統「build in」進去的，不是靠批次末的無菌測試「test out」的。
blocks.en: The same is true of the sterility of injectables: sterility is "built in" through a complete manufacturing system and is not "tested out" by the sterility test at the end of the batch.

blocks.zh: 變更管理（Change Control）與 CCS 的連結： 2.6 要求在變更前後都評估 CCS 影響，這意味著工廠的變更管理程序（Change Control SOP）必須包含「CCS 影響評估」這個步驟。這在舊版 Annex 1 中並無明確要求，是 2022 版的重要新增內容。
blocks.en: The link between change control and the CCS: Clause 2.6 requires the CCS impact to be assessed both before and after a change, which means the plant's change control procedure (Change Control SOP) must include a "CCS impact assessment" step. This was not explicitly required in the previous Annex 1 and is an important addition in the 2022 version.

blocks.zh: 無菌測試的統計侷限： 一般無菌測試抽樣量極小（通常 20 個單位），統計上無法保證整批產品都無菌。即使無菌測試通過，若製程中有已知的污染事件（如環境監測超標），仍不應放行批次。這正是 2.7 所要傳達的精神。
blocks.en: Statistical limitations of the sterility test: The sample size of a typical sterility test is very small (usually 20 units), so statistically it cannot guarantee that the whole batch is sterile. Even if the sterility test passes, a batch should still not be released if there was a known contamination event during the process (such as an environmental monitoring excursion). This is exactly the spirit that 2.7 conveys.

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 計劃更換 Grade A 充填區的 HEPA 過濾器型號（不同製造商，但相同規格）。根據 2.6 的要求，哪些評估步驟是必要的？
blocks.en: A CDMO plans to change the model of HEPA filter in its Grade A filling area (from a different manufacturer, but with the same specification). Under the requirements of 2.6, which assessment steps are necessary?

blocks.zh: 變更前： 評估新型號 HEPA 過濾器對 CCS 中「設計控制」要素的影響；確認供應商資格；更新 CCS 相關章節
blocks.en: Before the change: assess the impact of the new HEPA filter model on the "design controls" element of the CCS; confirm supplier qualification; update the relevant sections of the CCS

blocks.zh: 實施時： 執行 HEPA 過濾器安裝後的完整性測試（DOP/PAO 測試）和潔淨室分級再確認
blocks.en: During implementation: perform the full post-installation integrity test of the HEPA filter (DOP/PAO test) and re-confirm the cleanroom classification

blocks.zh: 實施後： 確認環境監測數據維持在可接受範圍；更新 CCS 文件反映最新狀態
blocks.en: After implementation: confirm that environmental monitoring data remain within the acceptable range; update the CCS document to reflect the current state

blocks.zh: 若一個批次在充填過程中發生了環境監測超標（EM excursion），但隨後的無菌測試結果為陰性（pass），是否可以放行此批次？根據 2.7 的精神，你的決策論據是什麼？
blocks.en: If an environmental monitoring excursion (EM excursion) occurs during the filling of a batch, but the subsequent sterility test result is negative (pass), can the batch be released? Based on the spirit of 2.7, what is the argument for your decision?

blocks.zh: 如何設計 CCS 定期審查的機制，使其有效而不流於形式？什麼樣的輸入數據（input data）應該納入每年的 CCS 有效性評估？
blocks.en: How can the periodic CCS review mechanism be designed so that it is effective and not merely a formality? What input data should be included in the annual CCS effectiveness assessment?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 無菌製造的核心原則涵蓋設施/設備設計、人員管理、製程監控與原物料管控四大領域，缺一不可
blocks.en: The core principles of sterile manufacturing cover four areas, facility/equipment design, personnel management, process monitoring and control of materials, and none of them can be omitted

blocks.zh: QRM 的優先順序為：設計 > 程序 > 監控。監控只是驗證前兩者有效，而非污染防護的主要手段
blocks.en: The QRM order of priority is: design > procedures > monitoring. Monitoring only verifies that the first two are effective and is not the main means of contamination protection

blocks.zh: 污染控制策略（CCS，污染控制策略）是 Annex 1 (2022) 最重要的新核心概念，要求廠商建立涵蓋 16 個要素的整合性污染管控計畫，並持續維護更新
blocks.en: The Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) is the most important new core concept in Annex 1 (2022); it requires manufacturers to establish an integrated contamination control plan covering 16 elements and to keep it maintained and updated

blocks.zh: CCS 是「活文件」，必須在每次系統變更前後評估影響，並定期作為管理審查的輸入
blocks.en: The CCS is a "living document": its impact must be assessed before and after every system change, and it must be an input to the periodic management review

blocks.zh: 無菌保證 (Sterility Assurance) 不能單靠終端滅菌或成品無菌測試——它是整個製造系統可靠性的綜合體現，必須透過完整的系統設計「build in」而非靠測試「test out」
blocks.en: Sterility assurance cannot rely on terminal sterilisation or finished product sterility testing alone: it is the combined expression of the reliability of the entire manufacturing system, and must be "built in" through complete system design rather than "tested out"
